description: Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises - Fichier complet des données publiques réutilisables is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SPF Economie. There are two types of data files: the full file (full extract):this file is created each month and contains all the active and discontinued data for all the registered entities and establishment units; the file containing the changes: this file is created on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays and contains all the data changes ... Coverage: SPF Economie. The portal shows the English title as "CBE - File containing all the public data available for reuse" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is SPF Economie. Its keywords include BCE, ZDU, KBO, CBE. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2025-01-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.be/license/cbe/full). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
